sentences.text: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes is a 2014 American science fiction film directed by Matt Reeves and written by Mark Bomback , Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver .	Matt Reeves	Matt Reeves	Rick Jaffa	Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver	Amanda Silver	Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver	Mark Bomback	Mark Bomback	Planet of the Apes	Planet of the Apes	science fiction film	science fiction film	Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver	Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver

It stars Andy Serkis , Jason Clarke , Gary Oldman , Keri Russell , Toby Kebbell , and Kodi Smit-McPhee .	Andy Serkis	Andy Serkis	Jason Clarke	Jason Clarke (actor)	Gary Oldman	Gary Oldman	Keri Russell	Keri Russell	Toby Kebbell	Toby Kebbell	Kodi Smit-McPhee	Kodi Smit-McPhee

It is the sequel to the 2011 film Rise of the Planet of the Apes , which began 20th Century Fox 's reboot of the original Planet of the Apes series .	Planet of the Apes	Planet of the Apes	20th Century Fox	20th Century Fox	Rise of the Planet of the Apes	Rise of the Planet of the Apes

Dawn is set ten years after the events of Rise , and follows a group of people in San Francisco who struggle to stay alive in the aftermath of a plague that is wiping out humanity , while Caesar tries to maintain dominance over his community of intelligent apes .	San Francisco	San Francisco

Dawn of the Planet of the Apes was released in the United States and Canada on July 11 , 2014 and was met with critical acclaim , with critics praising its visual effects , story , direction , acting , musical score , action , and emotional depth .	Planet of the Apes	Planet of the Apes

It was also a box office success , having grossed over $ 710 million worldwide , and received an Academy Award nomination for Best Visual Effects .	Academy Award	Academy Award	Best Visual Effects	Academy Award for Best Visual Effects

A third installment , titled War for the Planet of the Apes , is set to be released on July 14 , 2017 .	Planet of the Apes	Planet of the Apes	War for the Planet of the Apes	War for the Planet of the Apes
